book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第一册
unit_cn: Unit 6 Nurturing Nature 培育自然
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第一册 Unit 6 词表(p119 真词)+ 单元课文主题词;IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、自然保护/青藏铁路/大堡礁主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The train has been racing steadily across the plateau since dawn.
words.example_cn: 火车从黎明起就平稳地驶过高原。

words.example_en: Engineers built a massive bridge over the frozen ground.
words.example_cn: 工程师在冻土上建造了一座巨大的桥。

words.example_en: The railway was designed to protect the delicate ecosystem of the area.
words.example_cn: 这条铁路的设计旨在保护当地脆弱的生态系统。

words.example_en: The Qingshuihe Bridge is a famous landmark on the plateau.
words.example_cn: 清水河大桥是高原上著名的地标。

words.example_en: Passengers enjoy the splendid scenery as the train climbs higher.
words.example_cn: 火车越爬越高,乘客欣赏着壮丽的景色。

words.example_en: The bridge was built over permafrost to keep the ground frozen.
words.example_cn: 这座桥建在永久冻土层之上,以保持地面冰冻。

words.example_en: Groups of antelope move safely under the railway bridges.
words.example_cn: 成群的羚羊在铁路桥下安全地走动。

words.example_en: The wild animals stop to eat grass at their leisure near the line.
words.example_cn: 野生动物在铁路旁悠闲地停下来吃草。

words.example_en: Workers moved a large wetland to protect its special plants.
words.example_cn: 工人们移走了一大片湿地,以保护其中特殊的植物。

words.example_en: Cattle and sheep wander across the open grassland by the lake.
words.example_cn: 牛羊在湖边开阔的草原上漫步。

words.example_en: High levels of UV radiation made the work very hard for the builders.
words.example_cn: 强烈的紫外线辐射让建设者的工作十分艰难。

words.example_en: Sheep wander freely over the grassland beside the railway.
words.example_cn: 羊群在铁路旁的草原上自由地漫步。

words.example_en: Tourists travel far to enjoy the magical scenery of the plateau.
words.example_cn: 游客远道而来,只为欣赏高原上神奇的景色。

words.example_en: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau has attracted travellers for centuries.
words.example_cn: 青藏高原数百年来一直吸引着旅行者。

words.example_en: Ecotourism has become an important part of the local economy.
words.example_cn: 生态旅游已成为当地经济的重要组成部分。

words.example_en: The visitors went on a quiet walk through the green jungle.
words.example_cn: 游客们在绿色的丛林中静静地走了一程。

words.example_en: Building a hotel here might disturb the wildlife on the beach.
words.example_cn: 在这里建酒店可能会扰乱海滩上的野生动物。

words.example_en: More cars and planes mean higher carbon emissions every year.
words.example_cn: 更多的汽车和飞机意味着每年更高的碳排放。

words.example_en: The hotel operator promised the design would fit its surroundings.
words.example_cn: 酒店经营者承诺其设计会与周围环境相协调。

words.meaning_cn: 环境保护主义者;(自然)保护工作者
words.example_en: A conservationist wants to protect the turtles that lay eggs here.
words.example_cn: 一位环保主义者想保护在这里产卵的海龟。

words.example_en: Each candidate had to make a short video about the reef.
words.example_cn: 每位申请者都要制作一段关于珊瑚礁的短视频。

words.example_en: Out of thousands of applicants, only eleven were chosen.
words.example_cn: 在数千名申请人中,只有十一人入选。

words.example_en: She spoke in favour of protecting the natural heritage site.
words.example_cn: 她发言支持保护这处自然遗产地。

words.example_en: The reef caretaker job was advertised all over the world.
words.example_cn: 珊瑚礁看护员的工作被广而告之于全世界。

words.example_en: People wondered whether it was a genuine job or just a clever advert.
words.example_cn: 人们想知道这是一份真实的工作,还是只是一个聪明的广告。

words.example_en: The advertisement said the salary was negotiable.
words.example_cn: 广告上说薪水可以协商。

words.example_en: The pay is negotiable, and meals are provided for free.
words.example_cn: 薪酬可以协商,而且免费提供三餐。

words.example_en: Preference will be given to those with diving qualifications.
words.example_cn: 拥有潜水资格的人将获得优先考虑。

words.example_en: A diving qualification is useful for this kind of work.
words.example_cn: 潜水资格对这类工作很有用。

words.example_en: With a rope tied around his waist, he clears rubbish from the cliffs.
words.example_cn: 他腰间系着绳子,清理悬崖上的垃圾。

words.example_en: Ecotourism helps to conserve the environment for the future.
words.example_cn: 生态旅游有助于为未来保护环境。

words.example_en: Wildlife conservation is an important part of this project.
words.example_cn: 野生动物保护是这个项目的重要部分。

words.example_en: The passages let the animals move safely in their natural habitat.
words.example_cn: 这些通道让动物在自己的自然栖息地里安全地走动。

words.example_en: The team worked hard to protect the delicate ecosystem.
words.example_cn: 团队努力保护这个脆弱的生态系统。

words.example_en: The reef is now under threat from pollution and climate change.
words.example_cn: 如今珊瑚礁正受到污染和气候变化的威胁。

words.example_en: The reef is home to many species of birds and sea creatures.
words.example_cn: 珊瑚礁是许多鸟类和海洋生物的家园。

words.example_en: This delicate place is under threat from human activity.
words.example_cn: 这个脆弱的地方正受到人类活动的威胁。

words.example_en: The reef is made of living coral growing on dead coral.
words.example_cn: 珊瑚礁由生长在死珊瑚上的活珊瑚构成。

words.example_en: The Great Barrier Reef can even be seen from outer space.
words.example_cn: 大堡礁甚至可以从外太空看到。

words.example_en: Ecotourism encourages people to be responsible travellers.
words.example_cn: 生态旅游鼓励人们做负责任的旅行者。

words.example_en: The design should be in harmony with its beautiful surroundings.
words.example_cn: 设计应当与美丽的周围环境相协调。

words.example_en: The new hotel must fit in with its natural surroundings.
words.example_cn: 新酒店必须与其自然环境融为一体。

words.example_en: The workers had to overcome many difficult challenges.
words.example_cn: 工人们必须克服许多艰巨的挑战。

words.example_en: The thin air was perhaps the greatest challenge for the workers.
words.example_cn: 稀薄的空气也许是工人们面临的最大挑战。

words.example_en: We must do all we can to protect the reef.
words.example_cn: 我们必须竭尽全力保护珊瑚礁。

words.example_en: People all over the world became aware of the beauty of the ocean.
words.example_cn: 全世界的人都意识到了海洋之美。

words.meaning_cn: 独特的;清晰的;明显不同的
words.example_en: They moved the wetland to protect its distinct ecosystem.
words.example_cn: 他们移走湿地,以保护其独特的生态系统。

words.example_en: Some ecotourism holidays involve voluntary work such as planting trees.
words.example_cn: 有些生态旅游假期包含植树等志愿工作。
